recommendation: Keep the source fix. It removes stale pre-FHIR-43381 wording from an active user-visible search-parameter source without disturbing later productCategory decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-43381 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO request for R6 to make BiologicallyDerivedProduct.productCategory 0..* and update its definition and short display from the former broad-category wording to category-or-classification wording that explicitly allows multiple categories.
initial_application: Historical commit bdaca5e3b6abe0ad4b96a4e18a94ea8f66c20d82 applied the central StructureDefinition changes: productCategory became 0..*, the short display became 'A category or classification of the product', and the definition gained the multiple-categories example. The active SearchParameter source still retained the old 'Broad category of this product' description.
additional_context: BiologicallyDerivedProduct is active in source/fhir.ini and marked normative, so the resource-local search-parameter bundle is in current build scope. OO HCP minutes from 2024-02-12 corroborate the 11-0-0 vote and wording. FHIR-43380 updated the related category codes in the same meeting, and FHIR-45454 later changed productCategory to CodeableConcept; FHIR-45454 is already represented on the combined branch and explains the current datatype.
reconciliation: Updated source/biologicallyderivedproduct/bundle-BiologicallyDerivedProduct-search-params.xml so the product-category SearchParameter description now reads 'A category or classification of the product'. No StructureDefinition edit was needed because the element cardinality, short, definition, and later CodeableConcept datatype were already correct.
